_readme: Your own corrections to the Center sectors. They win over the sectors from Little Navmap and over the shipped
VATSIM sectors (data/centers_vatsim.json, Germany only). Empty: no corrections.
Each sector: name = station as spoken ("Bremen Radar"), fir = ICAO FIR/ACC code, frequency = MHz string
("123.450"), lower_ft/upper_ft = MSL band (lower inclusive, upper exclusive), polygon = [lat, lon] points.
Where sectors overlap at the same altitude, the first one in this list wins.
